hero.title: Automobile Engineering (UG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: Bachelor’s in Automobile Engineering is designed for students with an interest in vehicle design, automotive systems, engines, manufacturing, electric vehicles and transport technology. The subject is a combination of mechanical engineering and automotive applications. **Automobile Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is an option worth exploring for students interested in vehicle technology and engineering education.

overview: Important Note on Course Availability: The list of undergraduate programs published by the University of Mauritius for 2026-2027 does not include a dedicated Bachelor’s in Automobile Engineering. It does have a 4 year BEng (Hons) Mechanical Engineering and a 4 year BEng (Hons) Mechatronics Engineering which may provide related engineering foundations. These qualifications are alternatives and not similar to Automobile Engineering. Students planning to **Study Automobile Engineering in Mauritius** should understand the difference between a dedicated automobile engineering degree and related engineering courses.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Automobile Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Automobile Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Automobile Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
